business.description: Jainco Projects (India) Limited is focusing on loans and investments and making better use of funds. The company is registered in West Bengal and listed on BSE under code 526865.

outlook.statement: The world is recovering from war and various other challenges. We hope the economy will revive with the correction measures by regulators and also the Make in India boost. Hence we are prudently taking the decisions towards our funds and investments and monitise the opportunities based on best available options.
